newsitem.title: USA: CNB unit, Commerce to merge.
newsitem.headline: CNB unit, Commerce to merge.

text.p: The Citizens National Bank and Commerce Bank said on Wednesday that they had signed a definitive agreement to merge in a stock and cash transaction for an undisclosed price.
Commerce, an affiliate of Commerce Bankshares Inc, said the company expects the transaction to be completed during the fourth quarter, but released no further terms of the agreement.
Commerce said in a press release that it intends "to acquire through open market purchases approximately 225,000 share of its stock to fund this acquisition."
Citizens National Bank is owned by CNB Bancorp Inc.
Neither company was available for comment.
